name: Uzumaki Jonin

entries.name: Believe It!
entries.text: Once per encounter, gain advantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Crippling Strike
entries.text: Creatures who fail a saving throw from a jutsu you cast cannot use the Mobility (M) component until the end of their next turn.

entries.name: Fuinjutsu Master
entries.text: Ninjutsu with the Fuinjutsu keyword has an increased DC of +1 (already included).

entries.name: Fundamental Difference
entries.text: You may use Constitution for attack rolls, damage rolls, and save DCs of Ninjutsu with the Fuinjutsu keyword.

entries.name: Overwhelming Presence
entries.text: Creatures making Wisdom or Charisma checks against you do so at disadvantage. You roll Charisma ability checks at advantage.

entries.name: Strength of Will
entries.text: You gain advantage on Wisdom saving throws and ability checks.
This adversary has resistance to chakra damage and absorption. Fuinjutsu cast by this adversary gains +15 ft. range.

entries.name: Controller Passive 1
entries.text: Jutsu you cast that inflict conditions cannot have their saving throws enhanced by non-d20 bonuses (e.g. Bless).

entries.name: Controller Passive 2
entries.text: Once per turn, your jutsu that apply penalties also apply 1 rank of Concussed.

entries.name: Controller Action
entries.text: Cost: 3 Tenacity dice. All hostile creatures within 30 ft. must make a Constitution or Wisdom saving throw (your choice) vs. your highest save DC. On a failure, they cannot cast jutsu using their action or bonus action until the end of your next turn. Recharge: 5 Tenacity dice.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Make 2 attacks with an equipped weapon. You may replace one attack with a Seal attack.

entries.name: Kunai
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Shuriken
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Seal
entries.text: Melee Ninjutsu Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d4 + 4) force damage. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma save or take an equal amount of chakra damage.

The Uzumaki Jonin may take one Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn, once each round, to move, attack, cast a jutsu, or gain an extra reaction. It regains all Elite Actions at the start of its turn.

notes: Passive Perception is printed as 23 although Perception is printed as +8 (which gives 18); both kept as printed.
